title: Work and exploitation: encomienda, mita and repartimiento
goal: Read about the systems of forced labour in the colonies, and use impersonal se to say what was done to people without naming who did it.

items: Use impersonal *se* to say what was done to people without naming who did it.
Say what the encomendero received from the indigenous people entrusted to him.
Say who organised the mita in the 1570s and how people worked in it.
Say what the repartimiento was in New Spain.
Use the key words of forced labour: encomienda, mita, repartimiento, wage and shift.
